sloka: राक्षसैः सा परित्यक्ता पुरा विष्णुभयार्दितैः ।शून्या रक्षोगणैः सर्वै रसातलतलं गतैः ।। ७.३.२९ ॥
transliteration: rākṣasaiḥ sā parityaktā purā viṣṇubhayārditaiḥ ।śūnyā rakṣogaṇaiḥ sarvai rasātalatalaṁ gataiḥ ।। 7.3.29 ॥

translations.english: That city was formerly abandoned by all the hordes of Rakshasas, who, afflicted by fear of Vishnu, had gone to the nethermost regions, leaving it deserted.
